structure_reference: partner_dv_dbt / travel_dv_dbt -- models/staging/<lob>/ and models/automate_dv/{standard/{stitched,staging,hubs,links,satellites,references},augmented/{staging,satellites}}, the same layout as health_consolidated_v5_dv_dbt and maximus_health_v4_dv_dbt.

inputs_pinned.note: EXACTLY the 16 bundle files opus_motor_v2_dv_dbt pinned (its sha256 values, verified identical to the live bundle on 2026-11-16), read in place from the frozen outputs/ directory, plus data_7.js. Files the mapper added to the bundle ROOT after that build (RUN_CLOSURE_OPUS_MOTOR_V2.md and its facts, HANDOFF_RECORD.md, E8_STALE_DIGEST_CENSUS.json, SESSION_FINDINGS_FOR_CLAUDE_MD.md) are closure records, not mapping inputs: read for errata E-7 and E-8, neither of which changes what is built.

central_view_rule.verbatim: 1. we create a central view from source tables (by joining them , max upto 10). The join are selected so that it can feed sat as a whole (one or moew). That is we do not split sat across these views. Restriction of 10 can be broken if a sat needs more than source tables to build. If a view as less source tables join, we add more tables to it efficiently so that new sats can be built.
central_view_rule.hub_and_link_extension_verbatim: the views will have hub keys -- effectively each sat is primary key goes to hub -- so hub has to come from there, 2nd the links will also be from same view , as different hub keys and sat populatin comes from there

flat_source: BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS s3: a flat relational catalogue, every key an on-view expression. Any walk notation in a key is refused, never resolved.
normalise_note: normalise() is called inside md5(normalise(upper(...))) content-hash keys in this map and is defined nowhere in the bundle or this workspace. 'emit' carries the expressions verbatim and declares a precondition: a Snowflake function normalise(varchar) must exist before dbt run. health_consolidated_v5_dv_dbt runs 'refuse' for its map; the two builds differ on this and it should be settled once, estate-wide.

directives.scope: SCOPE_LISTS.json out-of-scope tables are matched by EQUALITY on the full table name, never containment; the map already carries none, which is verified, not re-applied.
directives.empty_key_shell: a resolved_key object with no expression (E-7: 540 blocks, the same set as those with no tier) is refused, never keyed on a bare prefix.
directives.key_derivation_prose: key_derivation is prose and is never parsed into a key.
directives.child_key_order: child_key_components where present -- per leg the source_column when resolved_on_view is true, else the literal value ('{COL}' is a column); a leg offering neither refuses the block. Else child_key_value 'Leg = VALUE | Leg = VALUE'. A declared leg left unresolved lands NULL and the grain is declared.
directives.single_writer_G3: for every single-active multi-writer group, the member carrying redundant_of is WITHHELD and its target is the single writer emitted; every group's decision is stated in build_artifacts/reports/single_writer_decisions.json, because redundant_of has no representation in SQL.
directives.grain_unratified_P2: a satellite with a block whose child-key value is its own column name is emitted as the map states and STAMPED grain_unratified in its SQL header.
directives.risk_object_key_spaces_P11: the four HUB_RISK_OBJECT key spaces are emitted exactly as the map states; no unifying key is invented, and OBJECT_ID is never stamped onto an empty key.

conventions.role_satellites: satellites on the one-hub LNK_PARTY_ROLE are built off HUB_PARTY with a literal ROLE_TYPE_CK
conventions.load_datetime: !CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()  -- as the reference projects write it, by the user's instruction
conventions.payload_names: UPPER_SNAKE of the data_7.js attribute name

staging_casts: every column nullif(trim(to_varchar("COL")), '') aliased lower-case. 00_tables_index carries data_type absent_from_source, so no type is inferred.
refusals_not_fallbacks: A key, child key or attribute that cannot be resolved from the pinned inputs is REFUSED and registered with whose call it is.
